about.paragraph1: Founded by Moe Naji after years inside dealership service departments, ClaimSafe exists to end the time and revenue lost to incomplete or rejected warranty claims.
about.paragraph2: What began with 3 dealership partners has grown to 18 in just one year. Today we partner with leading Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, Fiat, and Alfa Romeo dealerships across Canada — handling claim submissions, DI approvals, WAC negotiations, VOR escalations, and accounting.
about.closing: At ClaimSafe, we do more than manage claims — we become an extension of your service team.
about.imageAlt: A ClaimSafe team reviewing warranty claim submissions, approvals, and recoveries on screen

items.question: Which dealerships do you work with?
items.answer: We partner with Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, Fiat, and Alfa Romeo dealerships across Canada, handling their full warranty claim workflow from submission to payment.

items.question: How does ClaimSafe fit into our existing service department?
items.answer: We operate as an extension of your team — not a replacement. Your advisors and technicians keep working as usual while we manage claim documentation, submission, and follow-up in the background.

items.question: Can you help with an existing backlog of rejected or unfiled claims?
items.answer: Yes. Backlog claims processing is one of our core services — we review old, pending, or rejected claims, correct them, and resubmit to recover eligible revenue.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We offer simple, predictable monthly pricing with no surprise fees. Because our service is built to recover warranty revenue you'd otherwise lose, it typically pays for itself.

items.question: How quickly can we get started?
items.answer: After a short onboarding assessment of your current claims and workflow, we can begin managing new submissions right away while we work through any backlog in parallel.

items.question: Do you offer training for our advisors and technicians?
items.answer: Yes. We train your team on documentation best practices for repairs, diagnostics, and inspections so future claims are approved faster and rejected less often.
